svg.title: ANRI Risk Intelligence
svg.desc: A demo platform that tracks archive items by RFID, scores unusual movements and keeps a signed audit trail. 3 days to build the core demo, Jan 2026; 6 user roles with their own access; 3 dashboards: executive, security, compliance.
